_readme: Hand-verified phone numbers. This file outranks local/phones.json and is
NEVER written by scripts/enrich_phones.py — that is the entire reason it
exists. The monthly crawl scrapes whatever tel: link a course site happens
to expose, and on a corporately-managed course that is a switchboard in
another state (Black Bear shipped a Dallas number for a Parker, CO course
until the area-code penalty landed). A number checked by a human should
not be silently replaced by one lifted off a management company's page.
A wrong phone number is worse than no phone number: a golfer calls it and
reaches a stranger. So entries with phone=null are recorded here on
purpose, with the reason, so the next pass does not spend an afternoon
re-researching a course that is closed or has no published line at all.
confidence: high   = the course's own site, its parks/city department, or
medium = one credible source (course Facebook page, county
tourism page) with nothing contradicting it

elmwood-golf-course.source: elmwoodgolfcourse.com — the course's own site — and its chronogolf listing, agreeing
elmwood-golf-course.note: pueblocitygolf.com, which the CSV listed, is a dead domain. The Pueblo city multi-course site is pueblocitygolfcourses.com. chronogolf.com/club/elmwood-golf-club--2 exists but is a directory-only placeholder with no booking widget (checked 2026-07-25), and the course's own site says 'Call for a Tee Time'. Stays phone.

f-h-park-and-recreation-district.note: Haxtun. The district operates the course.

lake-estes-golf-course.source: evrpd.colorado.gov (Estes Valley Recreation and Park District) and its chronogolf listing, agreeing
lake-estes-golf-course.note: evrpd.com/golf/ is a JS redirect stub, not the real page. chronogolf.com/club/lake-estes-executive-9 was reported as live online booking; checked 2026-07-25 and it is a directory-only placeholder — course facts and a phone number, no tee sheet, no booking widget. NOT flipped to online. Same no-online-booking pin the CSV already notes for Mossland.

las-animas-golf-course.source: two independent listings agreeing, including its chronogolf listing
las-animas-golf-course.note: chronogolf.com/club/las-animas-public-golf-course is a directory-only placeholder (checked 2026-07-25) — no tee sheet, no booking widget. NOT flipped to online.

mossland-memorial-golf-course.source: course Facebook page plus a second listing agreeing

plainsman-golf-club.note: The CSV said Joes; the course is in KIRK. City corrected.

prairie-pines-golf-club.source: course Facebook page plus a second listing agreeing

quint-valley-golf-club.note: A competing number, (303) 822-8377, appears in older directory listings. Publishing the one the course itself shows.

sedgwick-county-golf-course.note: Julesburg. colorado.com, which the CSV listed as the website, is a state tourism portal rather than the course.

springfield-municipal-golf-course.source: bacacountyco.gov tourism page for the course
springfield-municipal-golf-course.note: Honor-system course with no staffed pro shop — the number reaches the county, not a starter.

stratton-golf-course.source: town/community listing for the Stratton, CO course
stratton-golf-course.note: stratton.com, which the CSV listed, is Stratton Mountain Resort in VERMONT. Wrong course entirely; website corrected.

fortuna-del-rey-golf-club-rv-resort.source: its own Chronogolf listing, which carries the number, the address (13650 N Frontage Rd, Yuma AZ 85367) and the operator's site
fortuna-del-rey-golf-club-rv-resort.note: The listing is an unclaimed placeholder — no tee sheet, marked no-online-booking — so the CSV's Booking URL was cleared. That left this venue with nothing to click and nothing to call, which is why the number is recorded here. Operator is Fortuna de Oro RV Resort (fortunadeoro.com).

challenger-golf-course.hold: Directory listings disagree on the number and none is the course's own site. Not publishing a coin flip.

mountain-meadows-golf-club.hold: One source only, and the course appears to be defunct. Also a trap: mtgolfclub.com and mountainmeadowsgc.com are a Mountain Meadows in POMONA, CALIFORNIA — not Red Feather Lakes. Do not copy a number off either.

prairie-golf-course.hold: No web presence and no published number anywhere. Nothing to verify against, so nothing to publish.

saint-andrews-at-westcliffe.hold: CLOSED since 2017; listed for sale in 2019. Two sources. Directories still carry a number for it — which is exactly how a golfer ends up calling a course that does not exist. Should be removed from the directory, not given a phone number.
